scripts.test:e2e: bun run seed:e2e && bunx playwright test
scripts.test:ui: bun run seed:e2e && bunx playwright test --ui
scripts.test:mocked: bun run seed:e2e && RUN_MOCK=true bunx playwright test mocked.pw.ts
scripts.test:headed: bun run seed:e2e && bunx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:flaky: bun run seed:e2e && bunx playwright test --repeat-each=2 --retries=5
scripts.magic: bun --bun run lint:fix && bun --bun run format && bun --bun run check-types
